scope: P5 local text-layer PDF extraction, persistent ExtractionRun and SourcePassage records, owner-scoped API/UI, and stale reference review when a newer source file version is uploaded

findings.evidence: DocumentService validates project ownership through SqlAlchemyDocumentRepository before reading local storage; every run and passage points at the exact SourceFile id; ExtractionRun stores processor and pypdf version; current API is owner-authenticated and mounted once through api_router.
findings.impact: Extraction provenance and ownership remain attached to the library's stable file-version identity; no cross-domain content copy or network lookup is introduced.
findings.exit_condition: Covered by owner-scoped API integration tests and AC-1 provenance evidence.
findings.next_action: Keep extraction text-only and owner-scoped in this phase.

findings.evidence: SourcePassage stores page-level anchors only; new file upload changes references to earlier versions to needs_review in the same database transaction. Extraction runs are append-only and repeat attempts create new records.
findings.impact: The system preserves both original files and prior extraction output while avoiding unsupported automatic anchor migration.
findings.exit_condition: Replacement test proves passage reference review_state changes while the old bytes remain downloadable.
findings.next_action: Require human review before future evidence workflows rely on passages from old file versions.

findings.evidence: The approved local-only boundary caps PDF upload size at 25 MiB, runs pypdf in FastAPI's synchronous worker thread, performs no OCR/external calls/background retry, and records failed/partial/empty outcomes.
findings.impact: The local MVP has bounded upload size and observable per-run outcomes; large-scale or remote processing capacity is not claimed.
findings.exit_condition: Any remote or high-volume processing mode receives a separate capacity, timeout and queue design before implementation.
findings.next_action: Keep remote processing, OCR and job queue outside P5.
